description: Search Japan's customs tariff schedule by product keyword (English) and get the matching HS lines with their headline duty rates (general, WTO, GSP, LDC). Use it to find which HS code and duty rate Japan applies to a product such as beans, green tea, lithium batteries, wine or cotton fabric, then call jp_tariff_lookup for every partnership rate. Optional chapter (1-97) limits the search to one HS chapter. Returns the schedule edition date; no match returns found:false with a hint.

chapter.description: Optional HS chapter 1-97 to search within (rates then come from that chapter live).

keyword.description: Product words in English, e.g. "adzuki beans", "green tea", "lithium battery". All words must appear.

name: jp_tariff_search
title: Jp Tariff Search
